title: High Water Mark

additional: Written In The Style Of The Hit Game Disco Elysium
If it were possible for a oneshot to also be slowburn then that is what this is
every skill gets at least one thing to say :]

summary: NORTH COURON PUBLIC ACCESS WATERFRONT - Stop me if you've heard this one: Two cops walk onto a beach in the middle of April. They've only known each other for a few weeks. One of them has only known *anything* for a few weeks, and swimming isn't on that list. He's wearing a ridiculous, 20-year-old bathing suit, and the city around him is teetering on the edge of warm spring bloodshed. It will never again be the same as it is now. He builds a sandcastle.
